claims.text: build_objects is the deterministic knowledge-object layer and emits provenance-backed fields.
The encyclopedia is enrichment only, not the denominator.
Validated state mutations go through _transition and illegal edges return False before mutation.
reset_to_range directly assigns RANGE and emits RESET, so reset edges are not STATE_TRANSITION edges.
Reset predicates run before active-trade management and state dispatch in process_candle.
RETEST is handled through evaluating_soft_conf, not a dedicated s == CRTState.RETEST branch.
Shadow resume transitions SHADOW_PENDING to SWEEP to EXPANSION and skips the strength check by design.
Two-sided outside sweep candles choose the swept_high branch because direction is SHORT if swept_high else LONG.
Trade construction requires active_range, sweep_event, displacement_candle, and non-inverted SL before a Trade is returned.
Active version is v2_multi_2026_04 and CRT predicate values resolve from active config sections.

The encyclopedia is incomplete by test and is used only as enrichment.

src/core/gate_intelligence.py:5-6 and :37 state that compute_crt_levels 'mirrors crt_engine_v2.py lines 1162-1201 exactly'. Lines 1162-1201 of crt_engine_v2.py are today inside try_sweep_to_displacement's sweep-age and body_ratio guards -- not SL/TP code. The actual SL/TP construction is at :2204-2258. The cited line range has drifted and now points at unrelated code.

src/core/gate_intelligence.py:6 ('CRT is sole SL/TP authority') and src/config_layer/execution_planner.py:8-9 ('that is CRT engine's sole responsibility') both assert a single SL/TP authority. Source contradicts this: crt_engine_v2.ExecutionEngine.build_trade (:2191-2292) is a second, independent implementation that never calls compute_crt_levels. The accompanying 'mirrors ... exactly' claim is also substantively false -- the two use different SL anchors (FMODE-011).

failure_modes.description: UltronRiskEngine.approve() (crt_engine_v2.py:2042-2123) is declared -> tuple[bool, Optional[RejectReason]] but its BitNet-rejection branch (:2090) returns a 3-tuple (False, RejectReason.LOW_SCORE, 0.0) while every other return in the function is 2-tuple. Zero callers found in src/, scripts/, or tests/ (grep-confirmed) -- superseded by approve_with_soft_conf per its own docstring. Currently inert because unreachable.

failure_modes.name: htf_range_reseed_window_asymmetry
failure_modes.description: RangeDetector.detect_htf_range() (:852-867) is window-agnostic -- callers define the window. initialise_range() (:2534-2553) seeds it with backtest.htf_candles_per_range candles (4 on v2_multi_2026_04). The reset path in process_candle (:2656-2658) instead passes candle_buffer[-atr_period:] (14 candles, 3.5x wider). h_ref/l_ref from this call feed sweep detection and retest-depth geometry directly.

failure_modes.name: live_debug_print_in_hot_path
failure_modes.description: try_expansion_to_retest (:1642-1647) contains an unconditional print("[CRT DEBUG] ...") on every retest-geometry evaluation, not gated by log level. Directly observed in this session's reproduction run stdout (17 lines, one per RETEST attempt on the corpus).

failure_modes.name: execution_deadend_on_build_trade_none
failure_modes.description: try_retest_to_execution (:3152) fires unconditionally, return value discarded, before build_trade is called; build_trade can return None (missing range/sweep :2194, missing displacement :2209, direction NONE :2223, inverted-SL guard :2231/:2237) with no else branch. process_candle's dispatch has no EXECUTION or RESOLUTION branch, so a trade-less EXECUTION matches nothing and idles until a reset fires the otherwise-illegal EXECUTION->RANGE edge (INV-009). Runtime: 5 EXECUTION entries, 1 TRADE_OPENED, 1 EXECUTION->RESOLUTION, 4 abandoned via RESET.

failure_modes.name: shadow_memory_partial_teardown
failure_modes.description: Of 4 teardown paths for the 8-field pending-displacement shadow object, only the successful-consumption path (:2856-2863) clears all 8 fields; the other 3 (non-HTF reset :1759-1762, TTL expiry :2714-2716, SHADOW_LEAK :2824-2827) clear 3-4 of 8, leaving source_htf/formed_idx/age_at_reset/reason_created stale. Non-exploitable today -- the gating field is always cleared and a fresh shadow overwrites all 8 -- but is literal partial invalidation of a single logical object.

failure_modes.name: dual_sl_tp_authority_divergent_anchor
failure_modes.description: SL/TP geometry has two independent implementations that disagree on the stop anchor. The backtest CRT spine uses ExecutionEngine.build_trade (crt_engine_v2.py:2191-2292), anchoring SL to the DISPLACEMENT candle extreme (:2215 LONG, :2222 SHORT). The live path uses compute_crt_levels (src/core/gate_intelligence.py:24-84) via src/runtime/live_engine_hook.py:911, which is passed the CURRENT candle's low/high (:914-915). No code is shared: crt_engine_v2 never imports gate_intelligence. Because entry is the retest close (:2202), the entry candle is essentially never the displacement candle, so the two paths yield different stops for the same setup. build_trade's own comment (:2204-2208) states the doctrine the live path does not follow. Same duplicate-ownership class as INV-009, but semantic rather than structural.

invariants.statement: StateMachine._transition validates target membership before mutating current_state.
Reset-to-RANGE is a separate mutation/event channel from STATE_TRANSITION.
process_candle computes absolute ATR and warms EMA before reset/trade/state dispatch.
Soft confirmation starts when expansion-to-retest succeeds and is bounded by soft_conf_max_candles.
The object-layer denominator is disk enumeration; enrichment artifacts are not coverage truth.
Every Sweep originates from one Range.
Every Execution originates from one Retest.
No object may have two owners.
